title: Admin user listing access + admin signup gated by special password (frontend-only)

requirements.summary: Gate Admin Users UI behind admin-only checks and ensure the user list loads only for admins and renders the full backend-provided list.
acceptanceCriteria: When logged in as an admin, the existing Admin Users page successfully loads and displays all users returned by the backend (not only the current user).
When logged in as a non-admin, attempting to access the Admin Users page shows an access denied screen and the backend rejects user-list requests with an authorization error.
The backend `listUsers` API remains admin-only and returns all user profiles stored in the canister.

file_operations.description: Update the user-list React Query hook to support conditional fetching (e.g., only enable fetching when the caller is confirmed admin) so non-admin users do not continuously trigger admin-only backend authorization failures. Use the existing authorization system signals already exposed to the frontend (e.g., isCallerAdmin). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure the Admin Users page only attempts to load the user list after admin status is confirmed, and treat authorization failures from the backend as an access-denied UX (render AccessDeniedScreen) rather than a generic error card. Use the existing AccessDeniedScreen component to present the restricted-access state (authorization component guidance: show AccessDeniedScreen when unauthorized). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Keep the /admin/users route guarded via admin-role checks and ensure navigation to Admin Users is not sufficient to bypass the guard. Confirm the route guard behavior still renders AccessDeniedScreen for non-admins using the existing authorization-driven admin check hook. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Confirm the 'Users' navigation link is only visible when the caller is an admin (using the existing admin-check hook) to reduce accidental access attempts by non-admin users. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add admin signup option in the signup UI with a required special password gate and submit the correct backend signup call for admin role.
acceptanceCriteria: The signup UI allows choosing between Engineer and Admin account type.
If Admin is selected and the password is not exactly "Hans@987123", the user cannot complete signup and sees an English error message indicating the admin signup password is invalid.
If Admin is selected and the password is exactly "Hans@987123", the frontend sends an admin signup request to the backend and the created profile is stored with role Admin.
The backend enforces the admin signup password check server-side (not just in the UI).
The admin signup password is never persisted in canister state and is not included in any frontend debug logs or error logs.

file_operations.description: Update the signup form to allow selecting account type (Engineer vs Admin). When Admin is selected, show an additional 'Admin signup password' input and require it to equal exactly "Hans@987123" before allowing submission; when Engineer is selected, do not require/admin-password-gate. Ensure the password is held only in component state for submission, is cleared after success/failure, and is never written to logs or UI error echoes. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a dedicated signup mutation for admin signup that calls the backend admin-signup capability (signupAdmin) and avoids logging or including the admin signup password in any debug payloads. Continue to use existing sanitized logging utilities, and ensure no mutation logs include the password string (even inadvertently via objects). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Harden signup-flow debug sanitation to ensure the admin signup password value is never emitted in console logs, including cases where the raw error message might contain user-provided content. Confirm password-related patterns remain redacted and that helper usage in signup hooks does not pass password values into logs. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Map backend admin-signup password failures to a concise, user-friendly English message without exposing internal details or the password.
acceptanceCriteria: When the backend rejects an admin signup due to incorrect password, the UI shows a user-friendly English message (e.g., "Invalid admin signup password.").
Error handling does not echo the admin password back to the user and does not include stack traces or internal backend details.

file_operations.description: Extend signup error translation to detect backend failures specifically related to invalid/missing admin signup password and return a concise English message such as "Invalid admin signup password." Ensure the mapping does not include internal backend details, stack traces, or any reflection of the password value. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire the updated error translation into the admin signup flow so backend rejections for invalid/missing admin signup password display the concise user-facing English message, and ensure the UI never echoes the provided password back to the user in any error state. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
